part.text:
Ran `npm test` (`node --test`): **10 tests total — 7 passed, 3 failed.**

| Failing test | Expected | Actual | Why it fails |
|---|---|---|---|
| `findByEmail ignores soft-deleted users` — `tests/auth-service.test.js:5` | `null` | Alan’s soft-deleted user record | `src/services/auth-service.js:5` filters only by email, without excluding users whose `deleted_at` is set. |
| `totalPaidCents counts only paid orders` — `tests/order-service.test.js:14` | `14600` cents | `1350` cents | `src/services/order-service.js:9` selects orders with status `'quote'`, so it sums the quote instead of the three paid orders. |
| `uncapturedTotalCents sums uncaptured payments` — `tests/payment-service.test.js:14` | `9900` cents | `4200` cents | `src/services/payment-service.js:10` selects payments with `captured === true`, so it sums captured payments instead of uncaptured ones. |

The nested assertion errors in the output occur because `src/db.js:32–35` catches assertions thrown inside test callbacks and invokes the callback again with that assertion as an error.

No files were modified.
